description: inbox.snooze hides an item until an instant at most seven days out (SV-D11); expiry is a comparison at read time, so the item returns by itself with no job and no restart. The answer shows the mark with its `until`, and the summary keeps counting the item while it hides — the number never lies (SV3).

item.reason: unattended loop denied an outward action

door.sentence: This loop is unattended, so outward actions are denied. Start an attended run, or (S56) grant the action.
